{{Quote|Five, Five, he's on your tail!''"<br />"''Can't get clear, vape him for me, Six-|"Talon Six" to "Talon Five"|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
"'''Talon Six'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] that flew an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]] as part of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]]. This [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] perished in an [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|ambush]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gravan Seven]] by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces.<ref name="WS" />
